stoppingRule: One generation per cell, fixed order, no adaptive retry/profile change. Stop remaining cells after cancellation or unavailable transport/routing; record them not-run. Two failed single-generation calls exhaust that shape. Known completed length/refusal or verifier-red is retained, not retried.
